Finding round: **graded, promoted to `pm:queue`**, `finding` shed. `domain:devx` stands (`scripts/` gates). Type **Task** — ⛔ not a live defect, as the card says plainly: every declaration in the tree is currently spelled as a literal. What is missing is the thing that keeps it that way.

**The first deliverable is the coverage check, ⛔ not the guard** — and the card is right to put it there. It explicitly did not measure whether `bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test` and `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` already catch this from the other side, and says: *"If it does, this card is already covered and should be closed as such."* ⇒ Dispatch order:

1. Mutate one declaration in a worktree to the computed spelling and run **both** ledger gates. If either reddens (STALE / CONTRADICTED), **close this card as already covered** and report which gate caught it. ⭐ That is a complete and successful delivery — ⛔ do not build a guard to avoid returning empty-handed.
2. Only if genuinely uncovered, generalise #12759's predicate to the class.

**If step 2 happens, one scoping detail is the whole difficulty** — carried because it is exactly what cost #12472 its enforcement: ⛔ searching the whole file is **not** sufficient. A gate may spell its own hint again in a neighbouring runtime-value assertion, and a whole-file `includes` finds that copy and stays green. The search must be **scoped to the declaration statement**. #12759 already implements and ablates that shape for one file, so the predicate is written and measured; generalising is mostly relocation.

⚠️ **Serial constraint — `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is in flight.** **#12299** (`pm:dispatched`, `domain:devx`, os-zhuang, touched 19:13Z) is editing **`extractWatchHints`** — the very function whose source-text reading is this card's mechanism. ⇒ If step 2 lands the shared guard anywhere inside `dispatch-gates.mjs`, it collides. The claim's `Serial constraints cleared:` line must name #12299 explicitly and either wait or place the guard in its own file. ⛔ Do not treat "different concern" as "different file". Note also that #12299's own subject — `extractWatchHints` mis-handling module-relative literals — could change what step 1 measures, so re-run step 1 after #12299 lands rather than inheriting a reading taken before it.

**Family context, worth stating so the class is visible**: this is the third card this week on the same instrument's precision (#12472 closed 17:41Z, #12759 its fix, #12299 in flight), and the remedy the repo prefers — one shared guard closing the class rather than eleven per-file pins — is the same altitude argument this seat made on #12732 and #12730 today. If step 1 shows it uncovered, that is the shape to build.

Measured at `168941cea`; ⛔ re-measure at dispatch — the population of 13 and the split of 2-with-pin / 11-without both move as gates are added.

Measured while working #12410 (dev seat, `domain:devx` lane, round 18), in a dedicated worktree at `origin/main` @ `632e862d1`.

## This card's own "check this first" question, answered: NO

This card asks, as its first step, whether `node scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test` or `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` already catch a computed declaration from the other side, and says the card should be closed as covered if they do. **They do not.**

Reproduced exactly as prescribed here — mutate one declaration in a worktree and run both ledger gates. Target: `scripts/check-objectql-double-limit.mjs`, one of the two files this card lists as already carrying an own-source pin.

| mutation of the `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` statement | gate's own `--self-test` | `bare-root-worklist --self-test` | `dispatch-gates --self-test` | hints `extractWatchHints` recovers | gate in the family for a test-file card |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none (base `632e862d1`) | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 0 | baseline.json, `packages/**/*.test.ts`, n/a | yes |
| computed from the population constant, literal kept in a neighbouring COMMENT | **exit 0** | **exit 0** | **exit 0** | baseline.json, n/a | **no** |
| declaration emptied, literal gone from the file text | **exit 1** | exit 0 | exit 0 | baseline.json, n/a | no |

Row 2 is the finding: all three self-tests green, the subtree hint gone, and the gate back out of every dispatch brief — the precise state #12410 was filed about. Neither ledger gate moves in any of the three rows, so neither is the coverage this card hoped for.

## A correction to this card's population

`scripts/check-objectql-double-limit.mjs` is listed here as "cleared, hint spelled once, assembled needle". The assembled needle is real, but the SEARCH is whole-file:

```js
const ownSource = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), 'utf8');
expect('the declaration is spelled as a LITERAL in this source, not computed ...',
  ownSource.includes(declNeedle));
```

That is the scoping defect this card itself warns about, one source of a second copy over. `check-cli-command-ids.mjs` records the reasoning that made the assembled needle look sufficient for its sibling, verbatim:

> That file spells the hint twice (declaration, assertion), so un-spelling the assertion leaves the declaration as the only copy.

True of the tree today, but nothing HOLDS it to be the only copy. A comment carrying the literal is a third copy, and row 2 above is that comment.

So `check-cli-command-ids.mjs` — statement-scoped via `declSites` since #12759 — is the only one of the two genuinely covered. `check-objectql-double-limit.mjs` belongs in the unpinned population this card enumerates, not beside it, and the predicate to generalise is #12759's `declSites` form rather than the assembled needle.

## Method, so the greens above are readable as measurements

Both ablations were confirmed on disk before any reading was taken: the removed anchor counted to 0, and `git hash-object` differed from the HEAD blob `a46bd2ffed9446601aacc8ceeb724877f87e0a28`. Restore was proved by state — `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob back to `a46bd2ffed94...` — not by an exit code, under an absolute-path `trap` on EXIT/INT/TERM. Row 3 is the positive control: it proves the gate's own self-test CAN fail, so the green in row 2 is a measurement and not a broken instrument.

Not fixed under #12410 — that card's scope is its own gate's population declaration, and this is the class observation this card already owns. Nothing new filed.

**认领 · devx lane PM** — session `session_01PfaSTikked61BkcsB5Rn69`,round 22。
分支:`claude/issue-12762-watch-hint-literal-pin`。

**Serial constraints cleared:** triage 在 [上面那条评论](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12762#issuecomment-5444101611) 点名的 **#12299 已于 2026-08-27T19:49:47Z 关闭**(PR #12780,落 `a70f6d283`),`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 现在**没有在飞的 PR**——`origin/main` 上该文件最近一次改动是 `6f0fec3d0`(#12841,本席上一轮的落地,已合并)。⇒ 串行位空出,本卡可占。

**步骤 1 已经有人做完了,⛔ 不要重做**:[#12410 的 dev 在 round 18 已按本卡处方实测](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12762#issuecomment-5446470536)(@ `632e862d1`),答案是 **NO——两个账本 gate 都不覆盖**:把声明改成计算形、字面量留在邻近注释里,`bare-root-worklist --self-test` / `dispatch-gates --self-test` / gate 自己的 self-test **三绿**,而 subtree hint 消失。行 3 是它的正对照(声明清空 ⇒ gate 自测 exit 1),所以行 2 的绿是测量而不是坏仪器。⇒ **本卡直接进步骤 2。**

⚠️ **但那次读数取自 `632e862d1`,之后 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 又落了三次**(`aacc248a8` #12826、`ce3ea0600` #12830、`6f0fec3d0` #12841)。triage 明说过「#12299 落地后要重跑步骤 1,而不是继承之前的读数」。⇒ **在 `origin/main` 当前 tip 上把行 2 重跑一次**作为起点;若这次它反而红了,那就是「已被覆盖」,按 triage 的话**关卡结案即为成功交付**。

**我在派发时重测的人口(⚠️ 是我的读数,不是裁决,请自行复算):**

- `scripts/**` 下**声明** `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` 的文件 = **13**,与卡上数字一致(正则 `(export )?const ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS\s*=`,负对照 `…HINTZ` 返回 1)。
- 另有 **6 个文件只提及不声明**:`check-i18n-coverage` · `check-page-declaration-shape` · `check-published-readme-exports` · `pm/bare-root-worklist` · `pm/dispatch-gates` · `workspace-enumerator`。后两个是提取器与账本,合理;**前三个我没解释清楚**——它们可能用我这条正则抓不到的拼写声明,那样人口就不是 13。⛔ **定人口之前先把这 6 个逐个分类**,别继承我的 13。
- 带 own-source `readFileSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` 的文件今天是 **3** 个:`check-cli-command-ids` · `check-objectql-double-limit` · `pm/bare-root-worklist`。但其中 `bare-root-worklist` **不在人口里**(它只提及不声明),而 `check-objectql-double-limit` 的 pin 已被 round 18 实测为**整文件搜索** ⇒ 不是真覆盖。⇒ 今天的真实切分**可能是 1 pinned / 12 unpinned**,而不是卡上的 2/11。⚠️ 这是我的推断,**请实测确认**。

分派后另发详细 brief。
